bounded_serialized_state.principle: Charge the complete controller state under the inherited V640 byte limit.

changed_weight_predictions.principle: A mixture fixture must change later votes, not only internal weights.

chronology_controls.principle: Injected failures must preserve parent bytes and restart identity.

cold_reducer.principle: Rebuild headline rows from raw evidence instead of trusting producer totals.

delayed_feedback_and_rows.principle: Causal order and complete per-arm rows prevent future-label leakage.

preconditions.principle: Only exact available V640 and repository evidence can start the fixture.

scorer_only_manifest.principle: Freeze evaluation labels for a scorer without exposing them to the controller.

stream_contract.principle: Independent sealed splits prevent evaluation outcomes from tuning development.

unbounded_reference_is_larger.principle: The reference exposes its extra memory and cannot enter bounded deployment.

chronology_control_rows.expected: birth follows the sixteenth due release

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: List only executable models used now; this task uses none.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each check names expected, observed, passed, and principle.
field_principles.chronology_control_rows: Retain prediction, release, update, birth, and attack order.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the actual UTC terminal decision time.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time and separate phase spans.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host execution is host; no device executes this fixture.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind the result to the active experiment task.
field_principles.feedback_schedule: Charge warmup and delayed future labels separately.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here while consumer values stay top-level.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Blocked verdicts name the exact upstream field and mismatch.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Complete findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Name the actual CPU solver or simulator work.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the actual no-LLM class without time padding.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, and failed model work.
field_principles.learning_contract: Record the equation, constants, nomination, eviction, and frozen gates.
field_principles.memory_budget_bytes: Inherit the V640 limit and report achieved charged state.
field_principles.mixture_fixture_ready_score: One requires frozen causal, archive, split, and byte controls.
field_principles.model_invoked: Count attempted loads or generations, including failures; this task has none.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash inputs, authority limits, ownership, and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development and evaluation seeds before outcomes are read.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, configuration, inputs, and immutable raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep each stream and arm with metrics, costs, abstention, and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914 with real UTC start and end times.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: State planned, attempted, complete, and censored fixed units.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact; retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Keep exact producer identities and exclusion state.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC invocation start.
field_principles.status: Use a terminal complete or blocked record; checkpoints hold unfinished work.
field_principles.stream_manifest_path: Bind independent splits and scorer-only label hashes.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain command, exit code, elapsed time, and log hash.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed class set; oracle authority forbids positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared evaluator authority; mechanics are not learned correctness.

honest_verdict: complete_circular_positive: bounded fixed-share fixture mechanics pass; prospective efficacy is not claimed; repository-wide suite retained unrelated failures

learning_contract.eviction: lowest archived weight; oldest creation order on an exact tie
learning_contract.new_expert_initialization: one uniform available-expert share before renormalization
learning_contract.nomination_source: current 16-label released buffer through shipped source-distinct induction
learning_contract.normalization: normalize all available expert weights after loss
learning_contract.prediction: deterministic weighted accept/reject vote; exact tie abstains

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: all eight development streams once; freeze all 24 evaluation streams
